title: E-Commerce Manager
description:
E-Commerce Manager - Peterborough - Attractive salary

ALH Recruitment are looking to recruit an E-Commerce Manager with immediate effect for our client who continue to grow and lead their market, based in Peterborough.

E-Commerce Manager

They're looking for an E-Commerce Manager to lead the growth, optimisation and performance of their online stores across multiple brands.

This is a hands-on, commercial role where you'll improve conversion journeys, launch new products, drive basket value and collaborate with marketing and content teams to deliver standout customer experiences.

If you love turning insight into revenue and want to build something with real momentum, this is the role for you.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and optimise online stores across multiple brands (products, pricing, navigation, promotions)
- Own e-commerce reporting and key growth metrics (conversion, AOV, revenue, retention)
- Plan and deliver campaign activity aligned with marketing and content calendars
- Work with web/development teams to implement improvements and new features
- Launch and refine bundles, products, upsell flows and checkout journeys
- Continuously test and enhance landing pages and purchase flows

What they're looking for
- Strong commercial mindset with proven e-commerce experience
- Confident using analytics tools to make data-led decisions
- Strong e-commerce expertise, with hands-on experience managing and growing sales across platforms including Shopify, Amazon and TikTok Shop
- Ability to manage multiple brands and stakeholders
- Proactive, test-and-learn approach - curious, creative and results-driven

What you'll get
- Opportunity to shape a key growth area within the business
- Freedom to test, learn and make a real impact
- A collaborative environment where ideas are valued
- Competitive salary and benefits

If you feel you have the skills and experience to step into this exciting E-Commerce role, please apply below:

title: Marketing Assistant
company: Infinity Recruitment Consultancy Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Our superb brand new client based in St. Ives, has experienced positive growth over the last 5 years and will be bringing the marketing function in-house for the very first time.

They are seeking an experienced Marketing Assistant to join them on a full-time permanent basis working Monday to Friday 8.45am - 5.00pm.

As Marketing Assistant, you will be responsible for writing and editing blog posts, raising brand awareness, updating the company website, creating and scheduling social media posts, dealing with customer engagement, monitor competitor activity and analysis, creating and executing email marketing campaigns and reviewing campaign analytics, compile basic performance reports, update marketing databases, assist with trade shows, exhibitions, and promotional events.

To be considered for the role of Marketing Assistant, you will have previous practical marketing experience, looking for your next challenge. You will have excellent content creation skills, a creative flair, strong verbal & written communication ability, strong attention to details and experience of using Mailchimp and Canva.

In return, our client is offering a salary of £30,000 - £32,000 (depending on experience) for the role of Marketing Assistant, 31 days paid annual leave inclusive of statutory holidays, pension after qualifying period, social events, free on-site parking, birthday day off, potential of quarterly bonuses cased on company performance

Send your CV now for consideration.

title: Marketing Campaigns Executive
description:
Marketing Campaigns Officer

Immediate start

6 month FTC with potential to extend
Hybrid Working (2 Days On-Site)
Up to £35,000

Are you a creative marketer with a passion for delivering engaging campaigns and compelling content? We're working with a well-established organisation seeking a Marketing Campaigns Officer to join their team on a fixed-term contract. This is a fantastic opportunity for a marketing professional with experience in campaign delivery, copywriting and digital marketing to take ownership of a range of high-profile campaigns that drive engagement, awareness and customer acquisition.

You'll play a key role in planning, delivering and optimising multi-channel marketing campaigns, working closely with internal stakeholders and external agencies to ensure campaigns are delivered on time, on budget and achieve measurable results.

Key Responsibilities
- Deliver end-to-end marketing campaigns across digital and traditional channels.
- Create engaging content for websites, email marketing, social media and campaign materials.
- Manage campaign schedules, budgets and performance reporting.
- Work collaboratively with agencies and internal teams to deliver creative marketing initiatives.
- Analyse campaign performance and make recommendations to maximise engagement and ROI.
- Support the development of new marketing approaches, technologies and customer engagement strategies.

About You
- Previous experience delivering marketing or product campaigns from planning through to reporting.
- Strong copywriting and content creation skills.
- Experience working across digital marketing channels.
- Comfortable managing multiple projects and stakeholders.
- Experience managing budgets and monitoring campaign performance.
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Experience working with external agencies would be advantageous.

To find out more or apply, please contact me directly for a confidential discussion.

title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
A successful subsidiary of a $ multi-billion organisation based in Cambridgeshire providing solutions to various industries and developing new markets, is seeking a Marketing Coordinator to support the Commercial Product and Marketing Team, coordinating practical market research, new product development, launches, digital content and sales materials. You ll have guidance working under the Product Management where you will maintain accurate information, organise activities, following through agreed actions while developing the business products, customers, end user applications with excellent communication skills.

Key Responsibilities:

Marketing & Digital
- Maintain marketing communications and content calendar against agreed priorities.
- Draft LinkedIn, website and other digital content, publishing following approval.
- Maintain and update website content and product information.
- Maintain brand consistency across marketing materials.

Content & Sales Enablement
- Prepare and update brochures, presentations, product datasheets and sales collateral using approved product information and templates.
- Coordinate product photography, video and basic content editing.
- Maintain an organised library of approved product and marketing assets.
- Support customer presentations, product-launch materials and training resources that explain approved product features and benefits.

Market Research, Product & End-User Support
- Gather competitor product, pricing, range and launch information and maintain market and retail/channel comparisons to support Product Management reviews.
- Collate test results, customer and end-user feedback, request sales reports into clear summaries.
- Assist with supervised end-user research and product demonstrations, recording application needs and improvement opportunities for the development team.

Events & Exhibitions
- Support trade exhibitions, customer events and product demonstrations.
- Coordinate samples, displays, collateral and shipping requirements.
- Capture and coordinate leads, content and actions following events.

Team & Project Coordination
- Maintain marketing/project trackers, deadlines and actions.
- Follow up outstanding product information, samples and marketing deliverables.
- Support marketing budget tracking and regular Commercial/Product Marketing updates.

Skills & Experience
- Marketing, Business or Communications qualification, or relevant practical experience; suitable for an entry-level applicant with evidence of relevant skills.
- Strong organisation and follow-up skills, with the ability to manage agreed tasks and deadlines.
- Clear written and verbal communication, attention to detail and a collaborative approach.
- Good PowerPoint and Excel skills, with confidence organising data, preparing straightforward reports.
- Comfortable creating digital and visual content.
- Experience with social media, websites, video/photo editing or B2 B marketing desirable.

Personal Attributes

Hands-on Organised Creative Commercially aware Proactive Detail-focused Collaborative

This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a passionate, fun and innovative company that continually strives to push boundaries and maintain the respect and trust of their Customers and co-workers.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Product Marketing Executive, Cambridge to £45 K (Hybrid)

A leading technology firm in Cambridge are requiring a Product Marketing Executive to grow customers for its critical products. The role turns product knowledge and customer insight into clear messaging, sales materials and campaigns across European markets.

Key Responsibilities include:
- Develop customer and competitor insight that shapes how their product is positioned and sold.
- Turn product information into compelling, benefit-led copy, and draft messaging and value propositions by customer segment
- Create sales materials, digital content and campaigns that build awareness, generate qualified enquiries and support sales teams and field sales agents.
- Strengthen promotion of the existing UK product and deliver agreed marketing activity
- Grow new product adoption among existing tracking customers.
- Track results and recommend improvements to messaging, content and campaign
- Reporting and budget tracking, - monthly enquiries, qualified leads, sales opportunities, campaign and web performance, and sales use.
- Build effective working relationships with Marketing, Sales, Product, country teams and partners

Essential Skills, Experience & Knowledge
- Practical marketing experience, with a portfolio of customer-facing copy (e.g. web pages, emails, ads or brochures)
- Experience creating sales collateral or supporting sales teams
- Experience organising multiple tasks and working with colleagues to deadlines
- Core marketing principles, customer audiences and communicating benefits
- Digital marketing channels, particularly email, paid search, websites and content
- Importance of accurate product claims, consistent messaging and approval processes
- Excellent copywriting in English: the ability to turn product and technical information into clear, compelling, benefit-led messaging
- Ability to adapt tone and copy for different audiences and channels
- Ability to organise and deliver marketing tasks and campaigns to agreed deadlines
- Attention to detail when checking content, links and product information
- Ability to work collaboratively, brief colleagues clearly and keep stakeholders updated
- Ability to interpret campaign and website data and use it to recommend improvements
- Confidence using digital workplace tools and learning marketing systems

Desirable Skills, Experience and Knowledge
- B2 B marketing or marketing a technical product or service
- Paid digital, SEO or landing-page optimisation
- Gathering customer insight or competitor research
- Supporting product launches, events, webinars or case studies
- Partner, reseller or insurer marketing
- Coordinating activity across different countries
- Telematics, fleet technology, software or connected hardware
- The role of product marketing: positioning, messaging and sales enablement
- B2 B buying journeys, lead generation and the Marketing-Sales relationship
- Campaign measures such as cost per lead, conversion and pipeline
- Fleet management, telematics or video telematics
- Experience with email marketing, CRM, website CMS, Google Ads or analytics tools
- Basic video editing, design or presentation skills
- French, Spanish or Italian language skills

title: Marketing Manager
company: Infinity Recruitment Consultancy Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Infinity Recruitment is delighted to be supporting an established and growing Peterborough-based business in the appointment of an experienced Marketing Manager. This is an exciting opportunity for a creative, commercially minded and hands-on marketing professional who enjoys having ownership of their work and seeing campaigns translate into real business results. You ll take the lead on the company s marketing activity, developing and delivering campaigns across digital and traditional channels, supporting business growth and managing a small marketing team. This is a fully office-based position, Monday to Friday, 8:45am 5:15pm.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Developing and delivering effective marketing strategies and campaigns across digital and traditional channels.
- Creating engaging content for social media, newsletters, PR and other marketing communications.
- Managing PPC activity, lead generation campaigns and monitoring campaign performance.
- Analysing marketing data and results to identify opportunities for improvement and growth.
- Conducting competitor and market research to support commercial decision-making.
- Developing the company s brand presence and ensuring consistent messaging across channels.
- Leading, supporting and developing a small marketing team.
- Working collaboratively with internal teams to ensure marketing activity supports wider business objectives.

About You

We re looking for a well-rounded marketing professional who combines strategic thinking with a hands-on approach. You ll ideally have:
- Proven experience across both digital and traditional marketing.
- Strong copywriting, content creation and social media skills.
- Hands-on experience managing PPC and marketing campaigns.
- Excellent communication, organisation and project management skills.
- Previous experience supporting or managing a marketing team.
- Experience working across both B2 B and B2 C environments.
- Previous experience within an FCA-regulated environment is essential.
- A commercial mindset with the ability to understand marketing performance and business objectives.
- A creative approach, with the confidence to bring new ideas and initiatives to the table.

What s on Offer?
- Salary up to £45,000, depending on experience.
- 31 days holiday, increasing with service to 38 days including Bank Holidays.
- Contributory pension.
- On-site parking.
- Employee reward schemes.
- Cash benefits linked to life cover.
- Ongoing learning and development opportunities.
- The opportunity to take genuine ownership of the marketing function within a growing business.

Cambridge

title: Senior Marketing Executive
description:
Proximity Recruitment are searching for an experienced & creative Senior Marketing Executive (£35,000 - £40,000 + Benefits) for a market-leading, high-end B2 B group based in Huntingdon, Cambridgeshire. With a turnover of £20m+ and operating at the premium end of their sector, the business is growing & needs someone to lead marketing delivery across the group.

The role is office based 5 days a week and reports directly into the Managing Director & CMO. It's a highly visible, senior position covering social media, content & design, email marketing and client communications. You'll have real scope to shape how the group goes to market and to progress your career within a luxury-led, fast-growing business.

Responsibilities include:
- Own & manage social media across the group's brands, including Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube & Facebook
- Plan & deliver group-wide content calendars that balance brand building, lead generation & client engagement
- Support & execute paid social campaigns, managing budgets & optimising for return
- Design high-quality digital & print content, including social assets, email templates, brochures, presentations & sales collateral
- Write compelling, commercially focused copy in a premium brand tone of voice
- Capture & edit photography and video content, including product, project & behind-the-scenes storytelling
- Own the email marketing programme in Mailchimp, from strategy & segmentation through to build, testing & send
- Work with the MD & CMO to sharpen and articulate the group's value proposition for each audience
- Plan & deliver proactive client communications, including launches, case studies & event invitations
- Partner with sales & account teams to produce tailored materials supporting new business
- Track performance across social, email & campaigns, reporting insights & recommendations to the senior team

The ideal candidate will have 3-5+ years' marketing experience, ideally within B2 B and/or premium or luxury brands. Strong design skills using Adobe Creative Suite and/or Canva are essential, along with hands-on Mailchimp experience and excellent copywriting ability. You'll be confident working with senior stakeholders at board level and comfortable juggling multiple projects across a group of businesses.

If you're a creative, ambitious marketer looking for a senior role where you can make a real impact, please don't hesitate to apply for more details.
